title: Design System: Sam Ananias Cases — Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero section titles only. Used once per major surface. Fraunces WONK=1 enables hand-cut terminals.

headline.purpose: Page-level H1 headings and section heroes. One per page. Same Fraunces WONK=1 treatment.

title.purpose: Section H2 headings. Border-bottom rule underline common at this level.

body.purpose: Standard prose. Held to ~68ch line length for reading measure.

label.purpose: Eyebrow labels, section numbers, badge text, technical metadata. Always uppercase, always wide-tracked.

shadows.name: hard-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover: simulates woodblock lifted from the plate. Zero blur, pure geometry.

shadows.name: hard-button-hover
shadows.purpose: Button and LinkButton hover shadow. Tighter scale than card offset to match smaller element size.

shadows.name: dark-card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Deep ambient lift on bg-surface elements in dark mode. The only blurred shadow in the system — invisible until a card surfaces over the true-black ground.

shadows.name: chess-slab-extrusion
shadows.purpose: Chess board 3D wooden block extrusion. Decorative only — not a pattern for general components.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, active, color shifts). Slightly snappy deceleration.

motion.name: ease-enter
motion.purpose: Elements entering the viewport or expanding. Decelerates into final position.

motion.name: ease-exit
motion.purpose: Elements leaving or collapsing. Accelerates out.

motion.name: reveal-keyframe
motion.purpose: Page entrance animation. Applied via .animate-reveal class. Disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: mobile-menu-out
motion.purpose: Mobile nav overlay exit animation. Applied via .is-closing class on #mobile-menu.

motion.name: duration-instant
motion.purpose: Immediate state changes: skeleton → content swaps.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Standard UI transitions: hover color, hover shadow, nav highlights.

motion.name: duration-deliberate
motion.purpose: Heavier state changes: panel opens, mode switches.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Page entrance reveals and major section transitions.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Small devices; padding shifts from 16px to 24px.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Tablet; section padding scales up, grid columns expand.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop; three-column grids, sidebar becomes persistent.

strokeWeights.name: structural
strokeWeights.purpose: Outer silhouettes, card frames, section rules, button borders.

strokeWeights.name: hatch
strokeWeights.purpose: Cross-hatch shading, texture dividers, group separators.

strokeWeights.name: fine
strokeWeights.purpose: Ultra-fine decorative marks, chess grid lines.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main CTA. Strategic Blue background with paper-white text and hard woodcut offset on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background-color: #4b648a; color: #f8f7f5; font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.2vw, 1.125rem); font-weight: 600; border: 2.5px solid #261e1a; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #3a4e6c; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #261e1a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background-color: #2b3a50; box-shadow: none; transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f8f7f5, 0 0 0 4px #2563eb; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Surface-white background with structural border. For secondary actions alongside a primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #261e1a; font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.2vw, 1.125rem); font-weight: 500; border: 2.5px solid #d2d4d9; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #f0f5fc; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #261e1a; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background-color: #d0dff4; box-shadow: none; transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f8f7f5, 0 0 0 4px #2563eb; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent background, border becomes visible on hover. Used for navigation-like actions and quiet secondary CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background-color: transparent; color: #261e1a; font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.2vw, 1.125rem); font-weight: 500; border: 2.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: #f0f5fc; border-color: currentColor; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #261e1a; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background-color: #d0dff4; box-shadow: none; transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f8f7f5, 0 0 0 4px #2563eb; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The primary content container. Flat at rest, lifts with a hard 3px offset shadow on hover.

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px; border: 2.5px solid #d2d4d9; background-color: #ffffff; padding: 24px; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #261e1a; } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3f3939; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: "Fraunces Variable", Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.14rem + 0.51vw, 1.5rem); font-weight: 700; color: #261e1a; margin: 0 0 8px; font-variation-settings: "WONK" 1; } .ds-card-title:hover { color: #4b648a; } .ds-card-summary { font-family: "Inter Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #3f3939; margin: 0 0 16px; flex: 1; } .ds-card-actions { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #d2d4d9; } .ds-card-link { font-family: "Inter Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #4b648a; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Chip / Tag
components.description: Technology tag or category label. Mono font, uppercase, wide-tracked.

components.name: Section Eyebrow Label
components.description: Ordinal section number + category label. Mono, uppercase, primary-colored. Appears above every section heading.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: block; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4b648a; margin-bottom: 12px; }

components.name: TOC Link
components.description: Table of contents navigation link. Compact, monospace caption, active state adds a 2px left border indicator.

narrative.overview:
This portfolio's visual language is drawn from the tradition of hand-pressed woodcut printing — where an artisan carves every line into a block, inks it, and presses it onto paper. Nothing in a woodcut is decorative by accident. Every mark costs effort, so only the marks that matter survive. The same logic governs this design system: each element earns its place through function, and the absence of ornament is itself the aesthetic statement.

The palette is ink on paper — warm off-white ground in light mode, true black in dark mode. Strokes are the primary design element, not fills. Typography alternates between the cut-letter authority of Fraunces (the Engraver voice) and the readable precision of Inter (the Reader voice). Layouts are structured, margins are generous, and density is intentional rather than compressed.

The chess motif is integrated as a primary decorative vocabulary — pieces, board coordinates, and hatched squares appear as dividers, ornaments, and interactive features. This is not decoration; it reflects Sam's actual relationship to chess as a thinking tool and metaphor for deliberate strategy.
keyCharacteristics: Linework-first: borders and stroke weights define every element before fills do
Two modes, one identity: warm paper (light) and inked plate (dark) are the same system expressed in opposite grounds
High contrast at all times: no mid-tone washes, no soft gradients except the one permitted chess-grid texture exception
Hard-offset interaction: interactive elements gain a 2–3px hard shadow on hover, simulating physical press
Chess as ornament: board patterns, pieces, and coordinates are the primary non-typographic decorative vocabulary

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Strategic Blue is the only accent color. It appears on ≤15% of any given screen surface. A page full of primary-colored elements is a page that forgot the point of a primary color.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: linear-gradient, radial-gradient, and conic-gradient are prohibited everywhere except the .chess-grid::before background texture (1px rule-lines, not a visual gradient). This exception must not be extended.

rules.name: The Engraver Reserve Rule
rules.body: Fraunces (the Engraver voice) is used only for Display, H1, and H2. H3 and below use Manrope. Applying the engraver serif to subheads, body, or labels erodes the display weight contrast.

rules.name: The Scrawl Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Gochi Hand appears only in empty-state captions or decorative catchphrases, at ≤10 words, ≥18px, and in text-muted or text-primary color. It must never appear in functional UI labels, navigation, or content headings.

rules.name: The Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: All interactive surface shadows are zero-blur, hard geometric offsets. Blurred box-shadow values are banned on interactive elements. The only permitted soft blur is the dark-mode foreground card ambient shadow.

rules.name: The Press Metaphor Rule
rules.body: Hover = lift (shadow appears). Active = press (shadow cancels, element translates into the vacated space by 2–3px). This motion must be consistent across all button and card variants.

rules.name: The Structural Border Rule
rules.body: All card frames, button outlines, and section rules use --stroke-structural (2.5px). Using a 1px or thin border on a card or button makes it disappear against the background — the engraving aesthetic requires its linework to be visible.

dos: Do use --stroke-structural (2.5px) for all card frames, button borders, and section rules.
Do use hard-offset shadows (3px 3px 0 var(--color-ink)) on interactive cards and (2px 2px 0 var(--color-text)) on buttons at hover, then cancel and translate on active.
Do use Fraunces (font-display, WONK=1) for Display, H1, and H2 headings only. Switch to Manrope for H3–H4.
Do use JetBrains Mono for all eyebrow labels, section numbers, badge text, and technical metadata — always uppercase, always tracked wide.
Do use CSS variable tokens in inline styles and component variants. Never hardcode hex values in markup.
Do use currentColor for all DoodleIcon and chess SVG strokes so they auto-invert between light and dark modes.
Do prefix section eyebrows with their ordinal number (01 ·, 02 ·) to maintain the manuscript-index structure.
Do keep Strategic Blue scarce — it should feel like an accent, not a theme color carpeting the page.
donts: Don't use linear-gradient, radial-gradient, or conic-gradient except in .chess-grid::before (the documented exception).
Don't use blurred box-shadow on interactive elements. The only permitted blur is the dark-mode ambient card lift.
Don't use Fraunces below H2 level. Applying the engraver serif to subheads, body, or labels erodes the display weight contrast.
Don't use Gochi Hand (Scrawl voice) in functional UI — navigation, buttons, form labels, or any string over 10 words.
Don't use system text emojis in any UI component. Use DoodleIcon vector SVGs or chess-piece SVGs instead.
Don't use mid-tone fills or semi-transparent color washes as decorative backgrounds.
Don't use rounded-full (pill) on cards or buttons. Pill radius belongs on chips, tags, and scrollbar thumbs only.
Don't render a soft drop shadow on any interactive element at rest. Flat at rest is the contract.
